newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada oks Ontario white wheat 1997/98 at C$104/T.
newsitem.headline: Canada oks Ontario white wheat 1997/98 at C$104/T.

text.p: The Canadian government on Wednesday approved federally-backed partial payments of C$104 a tonne for Ontario's white wheat in crop year 1997/98 (June/May), the Ontario Wheat Producers' Marketing Board said.
White wheat is Ontario's largest crop followed by red winter and red spring wheat, the OWPMB said.
While the federal government will guarantee payments of C$104 for each tonne of white wheat delivered to the OWPMB, the monopoly marketer predicted pool returns to range from C$150 to C$165 a tonne.
POOL ACCOUNT 1997 Initial Payment Projected Pool Return
Pool A: White Wheat C$104/tonne C$150-C$165/tonne
Pool B: Red Winter C$104/tonne* C$150-C$165/tonne*
Pool C: Red Spring C$110/tonne** C$160-C$175/tonne**
Pool E: Soft Red C$104/tonne C$150-C$165/tonne
Pool F: Common Red C$99/tonne C$145-C$160/tonne
Pool G: Feed Wheat C$78/tonne C$120/tonne

*Pool B protein: 11.5 pct at C$8/tonne increasing C$1/tonne per 1/10th increment to a maximum of C$18/tonne for 12.5 pct and over. **Pool C protein: 12.0 percent to 12.4 percent at C$10/tonne; and over 12.5 percent at C$18/tonne
